platformScope: Synthetic fixture platform, not observed production architecture qualification

artifactPreparation.trigger: One approved push to separate qualification branch; no default-branch installation or merge
artifactPreparation.network: Hosted build downloads only, including pinned base images and canonical Dockerfile package/tool/apt downloads
artifactPreparation.secrets: No secrets or credentials forwarded to Docker builds; checkout uses ephemeral contents-read token without persistence
artifactPreparation.compiledArtifact: Canonical Dockerfile build with parity publisher package, Workboard and declarations; docker-save archive with SHA-256 and image config ID
artifactPreparation.closureManifest: Every flattened-image regular file, directory, symlink and hardlink pinned in bounded compressed JSON without starting a container; exact named Doctor facade, build-info, runtime Node and publisher bytes separately joined
artifactPreparation.limits: Artifact content is preparation evidence. No claim of byte-reproducible apt/npm latest inputs or a minimal reviewed import graph; actual produced image/file hashes must be reviewed before execution
artifactPreparation.publication: Actions artifact only; no package, registry, release, tag, Gateway or production publication
artifactPreparation.retention: Upload only a successfully sealed image <=2GiB with required identity/layout evidence retained, plus <=32MiB evidence and <=64KiB retention receipt; each evidence file <=8MiB. Never upload filesystem.tar or unsealed images. Preserve bounded non-admitted gzip inventory and selector diagnostics on seal failure. Record omitted full sizes/hashes and bounded build-log tails without claiming omitted bytes retained

requiredCompiledEntries.claim: File presence and hashes only. No import, Worker launch, prepared authority readiness or complete bootstrap/migration/boot closure claim

artifactPreparation.buildTargetRelationship: Broker named pnpm build:ci-artifacts and pnpm tsgo:core as preparation targets. Existing exact-source CI build-artifacts and check-lint jobs passed. This preparation uses the maintained canonical Dockerfile pnpm build:docker route and its package-dist-import checks; do not replace the Dockerfile or reroute a denied local build

layoutMetadata.doctorSelection: Exactly one root openclaw-state-db-*.mjs terminal named export table exports prepareOpenClawStateDatabaseSchema; parse uncertainty refuses sealing. No fixed hash length, substring selection or import execution.
layoutMetadata.manifestEncoding: gzip-json, deterministic mtime=0; compressed <=8MiB evidence limit
layoutMetadata.failureEvidence: Write layout-assessment.json and complete compressed filesystem inventory before image validation. All 79 required path outcomes and Doctor zero/multiple/error details remain non-admitted metadata. Retain sealed image only if receipt, inventory, layout, preflight, iid and inspect evidence all retained.

runtimeAdmission.status: DESIGN_ONLY; no executable native policy or fixture workflow admitted
runtimeAdmission.boundaryChange: Explicitly replace Node Permission Model for this single hosted synthetic attempt with measured Linux namespace, Landlock and seccomp controls; approval required before any capability probe
runtimeAdmission.nodePermissionFsyncDenial: Actual Node runtime policy restriction, not auto-review rejection. No denied local route is retried
runtimeAdmission.hostCapabilityGap: This Mac lacks the intended rootless Linux Podman runner. Hosted Linux kernel/Docker capabilities and enforcement remain unmeasured, not known-denied permissions
runtimeAdmission.imageAdmission: Review exact Actions artifact id/ZIP digest, image archive SHA-256/config ID, Node file SHA, build-info/source tuple and complete runtime import/Worker/dependency closure before execution
runtimeAdmission.bootstrap: Reviewed native preload constructor, before Node main and before any thread, closes inherited descriptors beyond 0/1/2; installs fail-closed Landlock and architecture-checked seccomp TSYNC. Unsupported access bits, extra thread or primitive failure exits without fixture import
runtimeAdmission.filesystem: Read only frozen inputs, admitted compiled closure, pinned Node and named required system runtime paths. Landlock handles read/content and all required write/create/remove/refer/truncate bits. Metadata stat/readlink limits are disclosed. No operator home/config/state, source checkout, Docker socket or credentials mounted
runtimeAdmission.processes: Deny fork/vfork and clone without CLONE_THREAD; clone3 ENOSYS for supported thread fallback. Deny execve and execveat after trusted initial Node launch; all Worker threads inherit policy. Deny ptrace/process_vm and descriptor stealing
runtimeAdmission.network: Docker network none plus syscall socket-family/connect/bind/listen denial, tested for DNS, IPv4, IPv6 and loopback
runtimeAdmission.scratch: One separately owned runner-local 16MiB tmpfs, retained after container exit until failure capture; bind only that directory. This needs separately authorized task-local mount ownership. Docker tmpfs alone loses failed files. Inspect every writable mount; no separate writable /dev/shm or /tmp
runtimeAdmission.container: Nonroot UID/GID1000, dropped capabilities, no-new-privileges, private PID/IPC/cgroup namespaces, read-only image, no healthcheck/normal entrypoint; existing Docker baseline remains with additive restrictions
runtimeAdmission.capabilityProbe: Before fixture import, prove allowed scratch read/write/fsync, existing outside sentinel read/write denied in main and Worker, network denied, same-binary spawn/exec denied, SQLite WAL/backup/checkpoint/close and joined Worker allowed, installed policy and cgroups exact; prove deliberate deadline termination and positive cgroup emptiness. One refused probe stops; no broader retry
runtimeAdmission.phaseDriver: Reviewed additional readonly driver sets argv and sequentially imports unchanged fixture bytes with unique URL queries; no child processes. One aggregate budget across phases. Join native Workers before advancing or accepting completion
runtimeAdmission.failureCustody: Capture failed scratch files, stdout/stderr, policy/image/source/fixture hashes, exact argv/minimal env, elapsed/CPU/memory/scratch peaks and closure before unmounting only owned scratch; preserve failures and uncertain cleanup
runtimeAdmission.releaseScope: Synthetic preservation only. Does not qualify production committed WAL, all roles, loaded publisher/Gateway/Workboard behavior or backward writer switch

approvalRequiredNow: Authorize one non-force push of this reviewed artifact-only proposal to fr-meyer/openclaw candidate/v2026.9.8-runtime-qualification, one 45-minute hosted canonical build with its public image/package/tool/apt downloads, and seven-day Actions artifact retention. No fixture execution or boundary change included
approvalRequiredLater: After exact image/closure and native confinement implementation are reviewed, explicitly admit one bounded capability test and then the frozen six-phase attempt under the above Linux kernel boundary and runner-local scratch mount. No implicit reuse of old v9.7 or Colima approvals

brokerCoordination.reportedMissingArtifacts: Seven worker/export artifacts, including SQLite workers and normalization-core; exact broker list must be joined to retained complete image inventory before native execution admission
brokerCoordination.earlierNativeFailureClassification: Missing prepared authority and normalization-core occurred before migration; no proven migration defect or access denial from those failures
brokerCoordination.laterUse: Retain complete image and compiled file pins for separately reviewed original native bootstrap/migration/boot qualification
brokerCoordination.ownership: Broker owns original terminal provider/tool/child/audit/cleanup drain fencing and >1024 retained-state completeness; this proposal adds no competing runtime owner
brokerCoordination.separateGate: The bounded six-phase shared-state fixture does not qualify Gateway retirement, native drain fencing or large retained-state completeness
